shared_elements: figural subject with a body and limbs rendered on a stone surface
justification: The only correspondence is the wholly generic fact that each depicts a living figure: A is a single compact bird-like creature carved in the round with a schematic beak, eyes and folded wings, while B shows the lower bodies of striding human figures in flat low relief, with pleated robes, held staffs/objects, and a horizontal band of rosettes below. There is no shared motif, no shared relationship between elements, and the manner of depiction (blocky three-dimensional abstraction versus linear, drapery-detailed profile relief in registers) is entirely different.
